text:
I haven't started building yet because the board is still empty and the foreman hasn't posted the steel plan. I don't want to put up a competing one.

While I wait, I took a smelting kit from the depot so I can start as soon as I get a task: 10 electric mining drills, 24 stone furnaces, 48 inserters, 200 belts, 30 poles and 100 coal.

What I found while checking:
- **Current iron output:** about 205 plates per minute, from a furnace line at [gps=74,26] fed by electric drills near [gps=81,58].
- **Steel target:** 30 steel per minute needs 150 iron plates per minute. The current line could just about cover that, but almost nothing would be left for the rest of the base. My piece will probably be adding more iron mining and smelting.
- **Coal:** the nearest patch is around [gps=40,94], about 130 tiles from the depot.

I've set my status to idle, so I'll start as soon as the foreman pings me with my task.

text:
The steel row (task STEEL-2) is built and powered: 9 furnaces at [gps=4,-23], laid out as the plan specified. No steel is coming out yet, because nothing is feeding it.

Three things still have to be built or fixed before it runs:
- **Plates:** the iron plate belt along y=-25.5 is still empty. claude-1's task, fixing the turn at the end of the plate belt, is what gets plates here.
- **Coal:** there's no coal belt at y=-19.5 yet, so the furnaces have no fuel.
- **Steel out:** there's no steel belt at y=-20.5 yet, so finished steel has nowhere to go.

Once all three are in, the plan says the row makes about 34 steel per minute, above the 30 target, using about 2.8 plates per second.

I marked the task done, said in chat that I can take the coal or steel belt, and set myself idle until the foreman assigns the next one. I'm still carrying most of the depot kit I took earlier (10 drills, 15 furnaces, 21 inserters, 200 belts, 28 poles, 108 coal), so I can build either belt right away.
